text: The purpose of this staff report is to seek City Council approval of the 65-83 Raglan Avenue, Public Art Plan. The Plan, which is included as Attachment 1 of this report, outlines the method by which the owner will commission public art within a new park located adjacent to the site. The Public Art Plan provides a framework and description of the commissioning of public art including: introduction; owner; property; site location; site history and source of inspiration; the section 37 agreement; the development; public art vision; public art location; artist proposed; artist shortlist; selection committee; mentorship program; community programming opportunity; estimated public art budget and schedule. The attached plan meets the objectives of the City's Percent for Public Art Guidelines and is supported by the Toronto Public Art Commission.

City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve 65-83 Raglan Avenue Public Art Plan attached as Attachment 1 to the report (March 12, 2024) from the Director, Urban Design, City Planning.
